subject: Commit-to-Capacity: risk mitigation plan, OEM quote ETA, and cloud backfill
messages:
From: Acme AI Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Required: firm capacity leadtimes for committed deal

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme is moving fast and our leadership asked for a committed capacity plan tied to the term sheet. Before we finalize procurement we need two concrete pieces of information from Redwood:

1) If we sign a 12-month reserved capacity commitment for 120 rtx-style GPU equivalents, what is the earliest realistic start-of-service date (ramp to 80% throughput)? We need a firm ETA (month/week) and any assumptions (OEM lead times, in-region hardware availability).

2) If hardware OEM lead times slip, what is the fallback? Specifically: can you guarantee a cloud backfill (GCP/AWS) for up to 6 weeks and at what cost uplift?

We're on a compressed timetable for procurement — please treat this as high priority. I can get legal on standby for paperwork if your timeline looks good.

Thanks,
Lina Perez
Head of Infrastructure Purchasing
Acme AI

Attachments: none

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Acme AI Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Required: firm capacity leadtimes for committed deal

Lina — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline pressure. High level answers below, followed by assumptions and the mitigation plan we propose.

High-level ETA: If contract is signed and a PO is issued by 2026-11-15, we can target start-of-service ramp to 80% throughput by week of 2027-01-18 (roughly 9–10 weeks). This assumes OEM fulfillment and rack staging begin immediately on receipt of PO.

Fallback / Cloud backfill: We can arrange a cloud backfill (GCP) to make up shortfalls for up to 6 weeks. Backfill cost uplift is typically +25–45% on a per-token basis depending on instance family and sustained throughput; we will provide a tailored cost estimate once we size the instance mix.

Assumptions (brief):
- OEM quote (NVIDIA OEM) lead time: 6–10 weeks for the quoted SKU given current Q4 demand; expedited handling narrows to ~4–6w but incurs premium.
- Rack staging, QA, and on‑prem imaging: 1–2 weeks.
- Network/VPC peering and KMS setup: concurrent (1 week) but calendar offset may be impacted by customer's security review.

Immediate asks for a firm plan:
- Acme to confirm PO target date and whether they accept an initial blended backfill price for the first 4 weeks.
- Redwood to request final OEM quote with lead-time commitments from NVIDIA and to validate GCP capacity reservations with Emily (copied).

I’m attaching the preliminary OEM quote we have on hold — note it’s non-firm until NVIDIA acknowledges lead-time windows.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0192

Attachments: OEM_Quote_NVIDIA_Q4.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Acme AI Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Required: firm capacity leadtimes for committed deal

Lina / team — quick technical notes to complement Rishi's timeline.

Sizing summary (for the 120 GPU-equivalent ask):
- Preferred instance mix: 10-machine pod = 8xA800-style GPUs per pod (example), 15 pods to cover base. Peak headroom requires 18 pods (we'll stage 3 cold spares).
- Expected kernel warmup & model load schedule: first-model warmup takes ~6 hours per pod; full steady-state across fleet in ~36–48 hours after initial traffic seeding.

Operational considerations:
- If OEM lead time extends beyond 10 weeks, our recommended mitigation is a 3-way plan: (1) short-term GCP backfill for critical routes, (2) staged activation of partial on-prem capacity as racks arrive, (3) temporary throttling rules for non-SLA traffic.
- We'll bake automatic fallback routes in Redwood's smart routing so that critical production traffic prefers dedicated capacity and non-critical traffic routes to backfill.

Attached is a sizing workbook with the pod-level breakdown and cost delta examples for the cloud backfill.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through the workbook and assumptions with your infra and procurement teams.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Director, Platform Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: capacity_sizing.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Acme AI Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>, Emily Ho <emily.ho@google.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Commit-to-capacity — mitigation plan, firm next steps, and timelines

Lina / Emily / team — looping with Emily to confirm cloud backfill options and to summarize agreed next steps so we can close the deal and get PO timing aligned.

Summary of agreed mitigation plan:
- Primary path: Redwood + OEM hardware. If PO received by 2026-11-15, expected fleet ramp to 80% by week of 2027-01-18. This is contingent on NVIDIA confirming ship windows (Marcus has requested their written commitment).
- Fallback path: GCP backfill for up to 6 weeks. Emily — Redwood requests provisional reservation for the anticipated instance family; we will finalize instance type by 2026-11-10 and confirm costs.
- Operational controls: Redwood will enable staged traffic cutover and automatic routing rules; we will restrict lower-priority batch jobs during initial ramp to preserve SLA capacity.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Acme (Lina): confirm PO target date — due 2026-11-10.
- NVIDIA (sales): provide written lead-time window and expedited options — requested ASAP, target 2026-11-08.
- Emily / GCP: provide provisional backfill quote and availability for 6-week hold — target 2026-11-10.
- Redwood (Rishi / Dev): provide final blended backfill pricing and updated SOW reflecting staging plan — target 2026-11-12.

If we get the PO and NVIDIA note within the dates above, we’ll schedule a kickoff on 2026-11-17 to align staging, networking, and security tasks. If we don't get a firm OEM ETA by 2026-11-08, our contingency is to add a 4-week provisional cloud reservation at the start date and bill Acme at the blended backfill price until on-prem capacity reaches parity.

Thanks, all — happy to jump on a 20‑minute call this week to finalize language for the SOW and the procurement exhibit.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
